title: Watchmaker’s Vault device protocol v1
description: Structural wire contract. Domain validation additionally enforces credentials, actor bindings, role ownership, revisions, sequence/dedup state, monotonic freshness, puzzle correctness, and physical actuator readiness. Unknown top-level extension fields are allowed; payload/projection objects are strict.

allowed_roles.description: Authorization from authenticated registration. required_roles is participation, not authority.

pressed.description: True only for the dedicated HOLD SEAL control; direction/rune taps are discrete commands and do not set held state.
